desk-look panes that were already open now follow the shaded-surface change from 0.78.1, instead of keeping a light background in a dark terminal.

- A pane's background is set when it opens, so a pane opened before updating to 0.78.1 or before changing `/theme` kept the old light gray. When the shaded surface changes, desk-look now reopens its open panes with the new background (or none, falling back to Claude Code's own look). The pane in front and the keyboard focus stay where they were
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.78.2 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
